about: Power Automate flows for the Claude buttons (decision 0029). A specification for IT to build in the tenant, under the programme account: the store cannot reach the tenant, so building them is the one manual step. Each flow names its trigger, its steps and the contract it writes. Nothing here holds a secret: connector tokens come from Key Vault at run time.

flows.name: tm-post-card
steps: Look up the Teams user for the tm id in the programme's people list (SharePoint list kept by the head of training).
Post adaptive card and wait for a response (Teams), to that user.
If the card came from the relay (its data has session_id): HTTP POST the response data to the relay's /answer.
Otherwise: create command@1 ({action_id, choice, by, at, fields}) as a file in the programme library's inbox folder.

flows.name: tm-drafting-button

trigger.type: a Claude button pressed on a card

steps: Read deploy/claude/kit/drafting/<button>.json (published to the programme library with the kit).
Replace {{projection}} with the card's view as JSON, and each {{token:<server>}} with the presser's token for that connector from Key Vault.
HTTP POST https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages with headers x-api-key (Key Vault), the file's anthropic-version and anthropic-beta values; body = the file's body.
If stop_reason is refusal: post a card saying Claude could not draft this, with the manual path; stop.
Parse the first text block as JSON. Create draft@1 ({button, action_id, drafted_at, model, request_id, content}) in the inbox folder.
Call tm-post-card with a card showing the draft and Send / Edit / Discard.

flows.name: tm-acting-button

trigger.type: a Claude button pressed on a card

steps: Look up the presser's vault id (one per person, created when they first sign in to the connectors).
HTTP POST the relay's /press with {button, action_id, presser: by, projection, vault_id}.
Reply on the card: Claude is working; each change it wants to make will come to you to approve.

flows.name: tm-store-record
steps: Create the body as <session_id>.json in the programme library's inbox folder.
called_by: the relay, when a session ends
